title: VEVOR Crimping Tool, 22-10 AWG Ratcheting Wire Crimper Tool, Labor-Saving Electrical Terminal Crimp Pliers With Clear Metric & AWG Markings, Quick Release, Adjustable Force For Multiple Terminals
body_html:
Features & Details

  • For Common Crimping Needs: This ratcheting wire crimper supports a wide range of sizes from 22 to 10 AWG, with clearly marked Metric & AWG scales for quick, confident selection. Multiple jaw slots allow easy matching to different terminals
  • Effortless Crimping: The ratcheting crimping tool amplifies hand force and applies pressure step by step, ensuring smooth, controlled crimps. A one-touch quick release and anti-jam design keep the operation smooth and reliable
  • Dial in the Exact Crimp You Need: The star wheel of the crimper tool allows precise pressure adjustment to match different terminal sizes and wire gauges, ensuring tight, centered, and reliable crimps every time
  • Built Tough for Real Jobsite Use: Made from premium metal, professional jaw surface finishing, this crimper delivers excellent strength(45 HRC), wear resistance, and rust resistance. Built to withstand repeated heavy-duty use without deformation
  • Lightweight, Compact, and Easy to Carry: Weighing only 1.19 lbs, the crimp pliers fit easily into tool bags or belts. Combined with a non-slip ergonomic grip, it is comfortable to hold and ideal for on-site work, overhead tasks, and home DIY projects
